findings.title: import mutates caller's contents string and re-appends footer on every call
findings.body: `contents << ...` mutates the string passed in by the caller. In PollFeed the same `content` string is passed directly; in import_remote, doc.content is passed. On repeated imports of the same object or retries, the footer is appended again, and the sha1 computed afterwards changes every run, so the 'content changed' check always triggers a revision even when the source is unchanged.

findings.title: Unescaped URL interpolated into HTML footer
findings.body: The embed url is interpolated into an HTML anchor without escaping (`#{url}`). Feed items or embed URLs containing quote or angle-bracket characters can inject markup into the post, which is stored with cook_method raw_html and rendered unsanitized.

findings.title: raw_html cook method bypasses sanitization for all posts with that method
findings.body: cook returns raw content unfiltered when cook_method is raw_html, and the imported feed/embed content from remote sites is stored this way. This skips the Plugin::Filter and the pretty_text sanitizer entirely, so remote-sourced HTML (scripts, event handlers) is rendered on the forum for all viewers. Any remote page with script tags is an XSS vector.

findings.title: Throttle key set with setnx then expire is non-atomic and can leave keys without TTL
findings.body: If the process dies between setnx and expire, the key persists forever, permanently throttling retrieval of that URL. Use `set` with `ex`/`nx` options atomically.

findings.title: open() on user-configured URL and no timeout or error handling
findings.body: `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with Kernel#open allows command execution if the value begins with a pipe in older Ruby, and has no timeout. A slow or hung feed blocks the scheduled job indefinitely. Also `i.content` may be nil for feeds without content, causing NoMethodError on `scrub` and aborting the whole poll.

findings.title: Nil content from feed items crashes the entire poll
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` is called without checking presence; an item without a content element raises NoMethodError, aborting processing of all remaining feed items in the loop.

findings.title: Referer check is the only protection and sets ALLOWALL on every response
findings.body: The embed endpoint sets X-Frame-Options to ALLOWALL (not a valid value; browsers ignore it) and relies only on the Referer header, which is optional and easily spoofed or stripped. The check also raises for requests with no referer, but the embedded page is reachable directly. Framing permission is effectively unrestricted for any site that can supply the referer header.

findings.title: Anonymous requests can enqueue unthrottled retrieval jobs
findings.body: best enqueues a :retrieve_topic job for any embed_url; TopicRetriever throttles only per URL via redis, and the job can trigger fetching arbitrary remote URLs (SSRF-like outbound requests) for anonymous visitors, with an unbounded URL space.

findings.title: request.referer interpolated into JavaScript string
findings.body: The referer is inserted raw into a JS string literal inside a script tag. A referer containing a quote or closing script sequence can break out of the string; it is also used as the postMessage target origin, which is weak if the value is unexpected.

findings.title: post.cooked rendered with raw
findings.body: Cooked content from raw_html posts is output with `raw` without any sanitization; combined with the raw_html path this emits remote HTML unescaped into the page.

findings.title: Origin check uses substring indexOf, allowing bypass
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` is a substring test, so an attacker origin that is a substring of discourseUrl (e.g. a short host or 'https://') passes. Also the empty origin passes. Should compare parsed origins for equality.

findings.title: Disqus import now fetches remote pages and drops the category option
findings.body: The import replaces PostCreator with TopicEmbed.import_remote, which fetches each thread's link over HTTP instead of using the exported XML content, and the category option is removed without replacement. The import silently changes behavior and the removed option is still referenced in documentation.

findings.title: Adding a NOT NULL column with default on large posts table locks the table
findings.body: add_column with default and null: false rewrites the full posts table on PostgreSQL versions before 11, holding an exclusive lock during deploy on large forums.

findings.title: force: true drops existing top_topics data on migration
findings.body: Changing create_table to force: true means running this migration drops and recreates the table if it exists, silently deleting existing data. Editing an already-applied migration also does not re-run on existing installs.

findings.title: create_table with force: true in topic_embeds migration destroys data
findings.body: force: true drops any existing topic_embeds table on migrate; on rerun after production use, all embed mappings are lost, and duplicate topics would be created on the next import.

findings.title: Race condition creates duplicate embeds and topics
findings.body: The find-then-create in import is not protected by a lock or by the unique index; concurrent jobs for the same URL (retrieve_topic and poll_feed) can both create a topic and post, and the second TopicEmbed.create! raises a unique violation after the topic is already created, leaving an orphan topic.

findings.title: Update path ignores post cooking and embed url changes
findings.body: On update, revise! is called with contents that were not cooked the same way and the embed title is never updated; title changes from the feed are silently ignored.

findings.title: Update test does not verify the existing embed/post is updated
findings.body: 'Supports updating the post' only checks that cooked matches new contents; it doesn't assert the same post id or a single TopicEmbed row, so duplicate creation would pass the test.

findings.title: Spec asserts response is not success but description says 404
findings.body: The test 'is 404 without an embed_url' only checks should_not be_success, so it would pass on any error, and the success-path after hook asserts on responses for examples that never set a response, making failures confusing.

findings.title: Feed polling and embed settings lack validation and default off-safety
findings.body: embeddable_host is not validated as a bare host; a misconfigured value of an arbitrary host lets any site embed the forum. feed_polling_url accepts arbitrary URLs fetched server-side without restriction.

findings.title: user.try(:staff?) returns nil for anonymous users and staff bypass not enforced for jobs
findings.body: no_throttle is passed as nil when no user is found, which is fine, but the job runs TopicRetriever which then fetches the remote URL for any staff member's request without a per-URL limit; combined with no-throttle, staff requests can hammer remote sites.
